run_dir.ask: Folder TRIOS' automation reads run-list files from
run_dir.help: The folder the lab's TRIOS Auto / autoloader run queue import (or the person importing run lists) watches; see references/trios_files.md. Must exist and be writable by the account running mhp on the TRIOS PC.

export_dir.ask: Folder TRIOS exports finished runs into (text export)
export_dir.help: Set TRIOS' post-run export (File > Export, or the procedure's end-of-run export) to write a text file named as the run list's Export File column into this folder.

live_export_file.ask: Live export file TRIOS keeps writing during a run (blank for none)
live_export_file.help: Optional: when the lab's automation re-exports the running curve to one file, name it here and sample_temperature follows its last row.

pan_positions.ask: Number of positions on the autoloader rack

max_temperature_c.ask: Highest to_c an agent may program, per instrument ({"dsc": 600, "tga": 1000})

max_run_hours.ask: Longest program an agent may queue (hours)

load_equilibrate_s.ask: Seconds the pan robot and equilibration typically take (for progress and the wait)

poll_s.ask: Seconds between checks of the export folder

result_wait_s.ask: Longest wait for an export before the job fails (seconds)
